---
name: Feedback on an issue
about: Corrections, style notes, coverage requests. The system reads these and changes how it writes.
title: "Feedback: "
labels: feedback
---

**Which issue?** (date or title, or "general")

**What should change?**
Be concrete. "Item 3 misquoted the pricing page; it is $3/M not $5/M" or "Also this week items are too long" both work. Vague praise or complaints are ignored.
